Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly conflated the spellings Århus/Aarhus with the entirely different city Aalborg, claiming both Wikipedia pages “corroborate” Aalborg as the birthplace. In reality, both sources clearly state Århus/Aarhus (Aarhus), not Aalborg. This misinterpretation of Danish spelling normalization (Å → Aa) led to the wrong city.
